'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Armenian parliamentary election]]

Incumbent [[Prime Minister of Armenia|prime minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] seeks a third term in office and the retention of a [[Civil Contract (Armenia)|Civil Contract]] government. *[[2026 Kosovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Kosovo]] holds its third elections for the [[Assembly of Kosovo|Kuvendi]] in 18 months amid continued [[political deadlock]] and the lack of a [[Supermajority|two-thirds majority]] to [[2026 Kosovan presidential election|elect]] a [[President of Kosovo|president]]. [[Vetëvendosje]], led by incumbent [[Prime Minister of Kosovo|prime minister]] [[Albin Kurti]], remains the largest party in the Kuvendi but falls short of a [[majority government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kosovo-election-political-crisis-kurti-8e834897c0577af2e163929349bfa89a (AP)]
